mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% for three consecutive months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below its 6-month moving average signals manufacturing weakness, reducing corporate capital expenditure and future earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 6-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above its 12-month average indicates strong consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when RSAFS > 12-month average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals accelerating price pressures, prompting Federal Reserve tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market weakness, reducing consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for 2 consecutive months, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0%) increase cost of capital, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0%, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.
